news.summary: Climate change remains the greatest existential threat to Tuvalu, Prime Minister Feleti Teo told the UN General Assembly on Friday, warning that the pace and scale of international action are still falling far short of what vulnerable island nations need.

news.headline: Nepal PM urges climate justice after ‘Himalayan tsunami’ devastates country
news.summary: Nepal’s Prime Minister Balendra Shah brought a stark warning from the Himalayas to the UN General Assembly on Thursday, saying catastrophic floods that killed at least 1,400 people in his country laid bare the human cost of climate change, and the failure of the international system to protect those

news.headline: Australia urges global cooperation on climate, AI checks and international law
news.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese underlined the need for countries to work together to address the climate crisis, emerging technologies such as AI, and the breakdown of international rules, at the United Nations General Assembly on Thursday.&nbsp;

news.headline: Haiti at ‘watershed moment’, Prime Minister tells UN, urging full backing for security force
news.summary: Haiti is at a “watershed moment” in its struggle against gang violence and needs sustained international support alongside stronger national security institutions, Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé told the UN General Assembly on Friday.

news.headline: UNRWA work and mandate in ‘jeopardy’, Guterres warns
news.summary: The UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine refugees (UNRWA) continues to operate under “extraordinary pressure”, UN Secretary-General António Guterres said on Thursday.&nbsp;

news.headline: Palestinian existence under threat, Abbas tells UN, warning of ‘another Nakba’
news.summary: Israeli policies now threaten “the very life and existence of the Palestinian people on their homeland”, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas told the UN General Assembly on Thursday, urging the world not to allow “another Nakba”.&nbsp;

news.headline: ‘Peace remains only a promise’ for millions in eastern DR Congo, General Assembly hears
news.summary: The Prime Minister of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) cautioned against growing global demand for “blood-stained minerals” in the rush to net-zero, in her speech to the UN General Assembly.

news.headline: Haitians can’t wait to return home and vote in elections says Prime Minister
news.summary: “There is a people. news.headline: At UN, Pezeshkian turns terrorism accusation back on Iran’s critics
news.summary: President Masoud Pezeshkian opened his General Assembly address with a direct rebuttal to US President Donald Trump, who a day earlier had branded Iran the “number one sponsor of terror.”
